# Freelancer Mizan (Md Mizanur Rahman)

> Social Media Manager & Digital Marketer based in Sherpur, Mymensingh, Bangladesh. Specializes in social media management, YouTube SEO, Meta (Facebook) Ads, Google Ads, and Shopify store design. 5+ years of experience, 1000+ YouTube videos ranked on page 1, 200+ clients served worldwide.

## About

Md Mizanur Rahman, known professionally as Freelancer Mizan or dmmizan, is a Bangladesh-based freelance digital marketer who helps brands and creators grow through organic social media management, YouTube channel optimization, and paid advertising on Meta and Google. He works remotely with clients across Bangladesh, the United States, the United Kingdom, Denmark, and the United Arab Emirates.

## Services

- Social Media Management — full-service organic growth across 3-4 platforms
- YouTube SEO & Channel Optimization — titles, tags, descriptions, thumbnails, retention strategy
- Facebook (Meta) Ads Management — campaign setup, targeting, creative, A/B testing
- Google Ads Management — Search, Display, Performance Max campaigns
- Shopify Store Setup & Design — conversion-focused storefronts
- Custom AI-powered website development
